releaseNotes: Added Premium Black (pure OLED #000000) as a third theme alongside Light and Flow Dark (Green), with visual swatches and clean reorganized sections in Settings.

Expanded daily-life categories & 28 subcategories (Fuel & Vehicle, Shopping, Entertainment, Education, Travel, Personal Care, EMI & Debt, Salary, Freelance, Refunds), custom category/subcategory creation, and multi-select split tagging.

Added a dedicated multi-section Analytics & Reports hub (Overview, Cash Flow, Spending, Credit & Debt, Reports) with Weeks/Months/Custom date range, balance trend & forecast, planned timeline, period comparison, credit utilization & DTI, and downloadable CSV reports.
